title: Design a Vending Machine
description: Model products, inventory, coin handling, and a state machine for purchase flow.

data.text: Design a vending machine that dispenses snacks and drinks. Accept coins, show product selection, dispense items, and return change.
A vending machine has clear states: Idle, HasMoney, Dispensing, and OutOfStock. State transitions prevent invalid actions.

data.title: VendingMachine States
State validation is critical
data.text: Without states, a user could select a product before inserting money, or request change while dispensing. The state enum enforces valid sequences at compile time and runtime.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Product.Code is the slot identifier (e.g., A1, B2)
State enum enforces the purchase sequence
ReturnChange resets the machine to Idle
OutOfStock is a terminal state until refilled
data.takeaway: Vending machines are state machines with a small number of states. Explicit states prevent invalid transactions and make testing straightforward.
